case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Authorised, safe execution, meaningful human intervention and accountable research responsibility.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: No policy establishes operational authorisation, safety boundaries, or meaningful human intervention controls for autonomous AI agents executing scripts or controlling laboratory/computational workflows.
case_summary.case_note: Notre Dame's research and IT policies (N029, N032, N037, N194) provide only generic data, risk, and software-approval rules and do not address autonomous AI agents running scripts or laboratory workflows. Without operational safety boundaries or human-intervention controls, a critical gap remains; Protocol v1.1 critical-risk criteria were adopted after preliminary review.
